title: Clean Architecture Layering Enforcement
description:
Enforce clean architecture / open-closed layering across the repo: 🧰️framework (incl. the 💻️os product) must not know ✏️s or any plugin; ✏️s must not know concrete plugins; plugins must not know their extensions. Exhaustive violations audit found: 🧬️schema hardcodes 390 include_str! paths into ✏️s (39 apps); 🔺️mesh/🦀️component.rs embeds ~3500 lines of the 🗄️stdio plugin's format catalog + codecs (incl. a 1225-line DWG codec) duplicating the stdio plugin's own real implementations; 🚪️io/📇️registry/📇️catalog.json is a product-level owner table parked in the framework tree; 6 framework→s Cargo edges (🗺️surface→puzzle, →gis-terrain, os-host/os-flow/♾️infinite/wgpu-renderer→semio-s-3d/2d, ui-wgpu #[path] into ✏️s/🔨️modules/🧊️3d); 🛂️manifest's Contribution enum closed-lists 7 s-plugin topics; os modules (🪐️space, 🔁️workflow, 🏪️store) use s.* schema ids; plugin-registry/build scripts hardcode ✏️s/🔌️plugins, the studio keyword, and "s" defaults (9 sites); 🌀️procedural runtime-links 7 flow extensions bypassing the WIT extension-world (C1/C3 are dev-dep/test-only, C2 is the real runtime violation); semio-framework depends on the os product's semio-framework-os-kernel crate (inversion).

Approach: extend existing open mechanisms (crate [package.metadata.semio] → registry codegen → generated catalogs; string contributes/consumes topics; 🚪️io register_composer_entries/IoRouter; WIT extension-world; .sxt untyped contributions) rather than reinventing. Replace the closed Contribution enum with {topic, payload: serde_json::Value}; evict stdio material from mesh into the stdio plugin (mesh keeps only generic MeshData/Primitives/obj/glb/stl); invert schema registration to per-plugin self-registration; relocate the generic 3d/2d geometry kernels from ✏️s into 🧰️framework (fixes 4 Cargo edges at once); wire WIT extension-world properly and kill procedural's linked-extension fallback; rename os s.* schema ids to os.* and relocate 📖️playbook/🌊️flow cores into their owning plugins; genericize the registry/build/launch.json/package.json pipeline (taxonomy pluginAreas, host key rename studio→shell, DEFAULT_HOST_VARIANT, catalog-injection instead of upward TS imports); add dependency-cruiser + cargo layering-lint enforcement; and relocate semio-framework-os-kernel into 🧰️framework as the true bottom layer. No compatibility layers, no deprecations — old paths deleted outright once new ones land; every s.*-referencing fixture hand-fixed at once.

Full design (Rust mechanisms, TS/build/enforcement, and the 8-wave/~30-agent parallel execution schedule with file-ownership conflict matrix) is written to /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-current-codebase-doesnt-snazzy-dahl.md and its two sibling design files (…-agent-a449167ac23c2ab21.md Rust design, …-agent-aeb00dc5fed1a9bed.md orchestration/conflict-matrix). Execute via a parallel Workflow-tool agent workforce operating on this shared live tree (concurrent human devs + auto-commit bot present — no git writes, no worktrees), wave by wave with verification gates (bun ./📜️script.ts verify gate/verify, cargo check --workspace, plugin-registry check, grep-gates, dev-shell boot smoke, e2e) between waves.
